voice.name: Open Sector - Heavy Assimilator
voice.note: Shares the Heavy Assimilator voice designed for the Stalker (voices/stalker.json); the account's 24 custom voices are all referenced, so no new slot. Faster, rougher delivery for a sprinting brute.
voice.description: Hollow, guttural voice of an assimilated cyborg brute of an alien hive: very deep, heavily processed and layered, more growl than speech, few words, grinding metallic overtones, a drone of many voices beneath it.

fire.prompt: Two quick heavy armoured metal fist punches landing on a body one right after the other: meaty deep thuds with a hard metallic clank and a faint electric energy crackle, very short, close, no music, no voice

detonate.prompt: Sci-fi cyborg self-destruct: a quick rising high-pitched electric energy whine charging up for one second, then a violent bright plasma energy explosion with a deep boom, sizzling electric crackle and arcing static fading out, energy weapon, no gunpowder, close outdoors, no music, no voice

vault.prompt: Heavy armoured cyborg leaping over a sandbag wall: a sharp hydraulic servo kick, a fast whoosh of a heavy body through the air, then one heavy metal landing thud on dirt with a small rattle, short, close, no grunt, no music, no voice

stagger.prompt: A rifle bullet striking a thick steel shoulder plate: a sharp metallic ping and ricochet ring with a quick jolting servo whir, very short, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Heavy armoured cyborg sprinting fast: rapid heavy metal footsteps pounding on dirt, servo motors whining with each stride, clanking armour plates, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Heavy cyborg brute destroyed: electric sparks and short circuit crackle, a big heavy metal body collapsing to the dirt with a deep clanking thud, a dying electronic energy hum winding down in pitch, close, no music, no voice
